name: Bovine Colostrum (BMDB normal metabolome)
description: Bovine Colostrum medium from the Bovine Metabolome Database (BMDB) normal (healthy-subject) metabolite concentrations, mapped to BiGG exchanges, with a mineral base. Concentrations are medians of reported normal values (concentration_mM); original HMDB values retained per component.

provenance.citation: Bovine Metabolome Database (BMDB; Foroutan A et al., 2020, bovinedb.ca), normal bovine Colostrum concentrations. Primary refs PMID: 11242449, 22361340, 25637742.
provenance.notes: Normal-condition concentrations only; medians across reports; units converted to mM where MW/units allowed. Presence-based uptake bounds; concentration_mM + hmdb_orig retained. Mineral base added.
provenance.source_identity_evidence: provenance.doi == '10.3390/metabo10060233' and citation contains 'Bovine Metabolome Database'
provenance.license_name: Custom terms — commercial use by explicit permission

composition_provenance.definition: sourced = the cited source states this component; derived = the pipeline supplied it. Classification table: tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
